reasons: llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td:1762-1782 adds only 8 selection patterns (f32 <-> v2i16/v4i8, F and Zfinx). There is no other change: no fork logic removed, no early return, no test touched. Every added line serves B140.

The patterns match upstream llvmorg-20.1.8 RISCVInstrInfoF.td:713-722 (F: FMV_W_X/FMV_X_W; Zfinx: EXTRACT_SUBREG/INSERT_SUBREG(IMPLICIT_DEF) sub_32), with the same IsRV32 predicate. The only difference is that the destination or source register class is GPRAV2/GPRAV4 instead of GPR. bc91f3cdd57c exists and is in llvmorg-19.1.7..llvmorg-20.1.8. The sibling fork patterns come from fork commit 93e0fc427e93, which exists and adds the i32 <-> v2i16/v4i8 bitconvert patterns as claimed.

sub_32 on RV32 is meaningful: in RISCVRegisterInfo.td every X register has the 32-bit X*_W sub-register at sub_32 on both XLENs. On RV32 it covers the whole register, and upstream itself uses exactly this sub_32 pattern for Zfinx f32<->i32 on IsRV32. -verify-machineinstrs is clean in every case (see checks.matrix).

The cluster is correct: data/clusters.json maps ^llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVInstrInfoX(pulp|...)[A-Za-z]*\.td$ to insn-tablegen. The fixup subject matches that cluster commit, and the result file documents the deviation from the task's codegen-core owner.
